persona: Solo founder running a small invoicing SaaS
ask: help me set up a policy that makes sure nobody (including me at 2am) ever ships an endpoint that returns the full invoices table without auth. I've already almost done it twice
intent: Prevent any endpoint exposing invoice data from being publicly accessible without authentication.

persona: Agency lead managing many client workspaces
ask: we build backends for like 12 clients and every dev names stuff differently. help me set up a policy so endpoints are always lowercase snake_case, tables are plural, and functions start with the client prefix. flag it, don't block it
intent: Enforce consistent naming conventions across tables, endpoints and functions in a warn-only mode.

persona: CTO at a fintech handling card and bank data
ask: help me set up a policy so we pass our PCI audit. cardholder stuff can't be logged, can't be stored raw, and can't get sent to any vendor that isn't on our approved list. Stripe and Plaid only
intent: Stop card and bank data from being stored unprotected, logged, or sent to any third party other than Stripe and Plaid.

ask: help me set up a policy that makes sure we're HIPAA-safe. we have patients, appointments, and clinical notes tables and I honestly don't know what else we need
intent: Get broad, automatically checked safeguards around patient health information without knowing the specific rules.

ask: help me set up a policy that every endpoint under /admin must check the user's role is 'admin' or 'support_lead' before doing anything else, and that it never touches the tenants table without filtering by org_id
intent: Require role checks on all admin endpoints and tenant scoping on queries against the tenants table.

persona: Dev lead tired of messy code reviews
ask: help me set up a policy to stop the juniors from breaking prod. I'm sick of reviewing the same stuff, like missing error handling, no tests, giant 200 line functions, you know the drill
intent: Automate the recurring code-review checks (error handling, tests, function size) so they stop reaching the lead.

persona: Security and compliance person who isn't technical
ask: our SOC 2 auditor keeps asking for evidence that we have change controls and access reviews. can you set up a policy that proves we do that? I don't really know what that means in the product tbh
intent: Produce ongoing, auditable evidence of change control and access review for SOC 2, with no technical knowledge of how.

ask: help me set up a policy that no API keys or passwords are ever hardcoded in a function or endpoint, they have to come from environment variables. had a contractor paste a Twilio key straight into a function last month
intent: Block secrets embedded in code and require them to be read from environment variables.

persona: CTO at an EU-based B2C startup
ask: for GDPR we need to make sure that when a user deletes their account we actually delete their stuff everywhere, and that we don't keep customer data longer than 2 years. can you make a policy for that
intent: Make account deletion cascade across all personal data and enforce a two-year retention limit.

persona: Solo founder building an AI support product
ask: help me set up a policy for my AI agents so they can't delete anything or email customers without a human approving it first, and they shouldn't be able to call tools I haven't explicitly given them
intent: Constrain AI agent tool access and require human approval for destructive or customer-facing actions.

persona: Dev lead at a logistics company
ask: help me set up a policy that any external API call has a timeout set and some kind of error handling, our whole app hung last week because a shipping vendor went down and nothing had a timeout
intent: Ensure every outbound API call has an explicit timeout and handles failures.

ask: help me set up a policy so that production data never ends up in staging, and that our devs can only get into prod through the on-call process, not just because they feel like it
intent: Keep production data out of non-prod environments and restrict prod access to the approved on-call process.

ask: can you set up a policy that makes sure everyone on the team has done their security awareness training before they're allowed to touch anything with customer data in it
intent: Gate access to customer-data features on staff having completed security training.

persona: Solo founder watching a cloud bill
ask: help me set up a policy to keep costs under control. last month an AI call inside a loop cost me $900 and a background task kept retrying forever. also I want every table that stores customer emails to be tracked somehow so I can answer who changed what
intent: Prevent runaway AI-call and retry costs and keep an audit trail of changes to tables holding customer emails.

persona: Founder of a consumer app with a public signup
ask: our login and signup endpoints are getting hammered by bots, I want a limit on how often anyone can hit them, and I want to be sure every new public endpoint gets it too
intent: Rate-limit login and signup now, and keep every future public endpoint rate-limited.

persona: Operations lead at a retail business using the shop back office
ask: only managers should be able to approve refunds or change prices; regular staff can view but not change; make sure nobody can just give themselves manager
intent: Gate refund approval and price changes on the manager role, leave reads open to staff, and stop anyone from setting their own role.
